body.name: generated all-top-prefix path
body.construction: Compute \(\widehat\theta_n\), \(\widehat H_n\), and \(\widehat s_n(z)\) by their displayed empirical formulas; for each external index \(j\), compute the lexicographic rank \(\widehat r_{n,j}\) of \((\widehat s_n(Z_j),V_j,j)\), and set \(\widehat{\mathcal S}_{n,k}=\{j:\widehat r_{n,j}\le k\}\) for every \(k\in\mathcal K_n\).
